description: ANSWERS "what bills about X has Congress introduced" / "recent congressional bills on X" / "federal legislation about X" / "find the <Named> Act" — searches US FEDERAL congressional bills (US House & Senate, national laws) BY BILL NAME, SUBJECT OR KEYWORD, including recently introduced ones. Full-text search is via GovInfo (the GPO's index of the same bill documents congress.gov itself searches — congress.gov's own /bill endpoint has no keyword query at all), then RE-RANKED locally by how well each bill's title matches the query — exact title first, then a title containing the phrase, then all query words, then partial overlap — so the first result is the best title match and each bill carries its match tier. Pass `congress` to restrict to one Congress (filtered locally against the search results — may miss a match if it falls outside GovInfo's own top results for that query). Prefer this over a date-sorted recent-bills listing whenever the question names a topic or a bill. Returns bill type, number, title, status, sponsor, and introduction date (via congress.gov). Use get_bill with congress + bill_type + number for full details. Requires an API key (see get_bill). NOTE: this is the US Congress (federal) ONLY — for STATE legislature bills (e.g. California, Texas, New York, or any US state legislation) use legiscan or openstates instead, not this tool.

congress.description: Optional Congress number (e.g. 111) to restrict results to, filtered locally against the search results.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

query.description: Bill name, keywords or subject to match against bill titles, e.g. "Lower Energy Costs Act" or "crypto"

name: search_bills
